topic: Sakazuki called the Five Elders puppets of the Celestial Dragons after the government falsified the news of Doflamingo's resignation, then Fujitora exposed the cover-up
title: Sakazuki Called The Five Elders Puppets Over Doflamingo
description: Fleet Admiral Sakazuki once called the Five Elders puppets, and it was about the false news of Doflamingo's resignation. Here is what that fight really shows. Was it damage control or protection?
comment: Was the cover-up of Doflamingo's defeat just Warlord damage control, or did the Elders actually want him protected? Pick one.

lines.text: Puppets. Fleet Admiral Sakazuki used that word on the Five Elders, and it was about Doflamingo.

shot.fallback: furious marine admiral facing five old men in white robes

lines.text: Doflamingo lost Dressrosa, yet the world was told he resigned by choice.

shot.fallback: newspaper front page about a king stepping down

lines.text: That story was a lie, and the World Government helped write it.

shot.fallback: official in white suit holding a false news bulletin

lines.text: Sakazuki demanded to know why the whole world was misled for one pirate.

shot.search: Sakazuki Marine Headquarters Five Elders confront
shot.fallback: angry admiral slamming a table in front of old men

lines.text: Then he called the Elders puppets of the Celestial Dragons.

shot.search: Sakazuki Five Elders puppets Celestial Dragons
shot.fallback: scarred admiral pointing at five elders in robes

lines.text: He was furious that CP0 had acted over the Marines' heads.

shot.search: CP0 Cipher Pol Sakazuki Marines Elders
shot.fallback: masked agents in black suits standing behind five elders

lines.text: Law spotted it instantly: only a World Noble could rewrite the news like that.

shot.search: Law Doflamingo World Noble news Dressrosa
shot.fallback: tattooed man in a spotted hat looking suspicious

lines.text: Fujitora then announced Doflamingo's crimes before the Elders knew. The cover-up collapsed.

shot.fallback: blind admiral in a purple coat addressing a crowd

lines.text: Call it damage control. But that doesn't need CP0 acting behind the Marines' backs.

shot.search: Seven Warlords of the Sea Doflamingo Marines
shot.fallback: row of pirates in coats standing before marine officers

lines.text: Someone wanted that name kept clean, and that's a strange favour for a man who just lost.

shot.fallback: grinning man in a feather coat and sunglasses

lines.text: So what was he worth to them that they'd risk a fight with their own Fleet Admiral?

shot.fallback: smiling prisoner in a deep dark cell

lines.text: And that's why Sakazuki looked the Elders in the eye and said one word...

shot.fallback: stern fleet admiral in a long white coat
